house.title: Build House
house.desc: Houses population. Drop off point for wood and food.

palisade.title: Build Palisade Wall
palisade.desc: Wooden wall that is cheap and easy to build.

swordsman upgrade.title: Research Swordmastery
swordsman upgrade.desc: Upgrade swordsman into more powerful, armored swordmasters.

heavy bomber upgrade.title: Research Heavy Bomber
heavy bomber upgrade.desc: Upgrades bomber into heavy bombers, which have more hitpoints, pierce armor, bomb carry capacity and fuel efficiency.

cavalry2 upgrade.title: Research Heavy Cavalry
cavalry2 upgrade.desc: Upgrade cavalry to become armored and more powerful.

infantryman upgrade.title: Research Infantryman
infantryman upgrade.desc: Upgrade riflemen into infantrymen. They are more powerful and have faster reload.

fighter.title: Create Fighter
fighter.desc: Quick and nimble aeroplane with twin machine guns. Attack bonus vs. other planes.

infantryman.title: Create Infantryman
infantryman.desc: Expert infantry unit carrying a rifle with a fast rate of fire.

waffen.title: Create Waffen SS
waffen.desc: A powerful specialist infantry unit that underwent training in Nazi military tactics. +5 bonus damage vs. villagers.

elite waffen.title: Create Elite Waffen SS
elite waffen.desc: A powerful specialist infantry unit that underwent advanced training in Nazi military tactics. +5 bonus damage vs. villagers.

gasoline.title: Research Gasoline
gasoline.desc: Improves the fuel efficiency of planes by 40%

artillery.title: Create Artillery
artillery.desc: Slow moving ranged weapon that launches explosive projectiles. Has a minimum range. Effective vs. grouped units. Attack bonus vs. tanks.

synthetic fuel.title: Research Synthetic Fuel
synthetic fuel.desc: Improves the fuel efficiency of planes by 60%

elite waffen upgrade.title: Upgrade to Elite Waffen SS
elite waffen upgrade.desc: Upgrade Waffen SS to the elite rank. They have more HP, armor and power.

camel.title: Camel
camel.desc: A rider with a large sabre mounted on a camel. Attack bonus vs. cavalry.

camel corps.title: Camel Corps
camel corps.desc: Ottoman Empire unique unit. An elite rider with a large sabre mounted on an armored camel. Attack bonus vs. cavalry.

camel corps upgrade.title: Upgrade to Camel Corps
camel corps upgrade.desc: Upgrade camels into more powerful armored camels, which form a part of the specialist camelry regiment named Camel Corps.

fortress.title: Build Fortress
fortress.desc: Defensive fortification that houses artillery cannons to fire upon approaching enemies.

aa gun.title: Create AA Gun
aa gun.desc: Anti-aircraft gun. Can only destroy aerial targets.

flak.title: Create Flak
flak.desc: Powerful anti-aircraft gun. Can only destroy aerial targets.

flak upgrade.title: Upgrade to Flak
flak upgrade.desc: Upgrade your AA guns into Flaks, which are more powerful.

flak tower upgrade.title: Upgrade to Flak Tower
flak tower upgrade.desc: Upgrade your towers into Flak Towers, which are more powerful.

group.title: Group
group.desc: Instruct your units to adopt a grouped formation.

jet fighter.title: Create Jet Fighter
jet fighter.desc: Powerful fighter with extreme speed and fire power. Attack bonus vs. other planes.

ohka.title: Create Ohka
ohka.desc: Japanese unique unit. Rocket powered kamikaze attack aircraft. Fast but difficult to maneuvre and poor range. Must be sacrificed and crash to detonate. Attack bonus vs. ships.

biplane.title: Create Biplane
biplane.desc: A fixed-wing aircraft with stacked wings. A machine gun can be fired from the cockpit.

light tank.title: Create Light Tank
light tank.desc: Heavily armored slow moving unit. Attack bonus vs. buildings.

janissary.title: Create Janissary
janissary.desc: Ottoman Empire unique gunpowder unit. Carries a powerful blunderbuss with a slow reload.

royal janissary.title: Create Royal Janissary
royal janissary.desc: Ottoman Empire unique elite gunpowder unit. Carries a powerful blunderbuss with a slow reload.

royal janissary upgrade.title: Upgrade to Royal Janissary
royal janissary upgrade.desc: Upgrade Janissaries into Royal Janissaries, which have more armor and are more powerful.

ballistics.title: Research Ballistics
ballistics.desc: Projectiles are fired more accurately at moving targets.

horsewagon.title: Research Horse Wagon
horsewagon.desc: Civilians carry more resources, move 10% faster, and are 10% more efficient at collecting food.

smelting.title: Research Smelting
smelting.desc: Improves iron ore mining efficiency by 15%

beneficiation.title: Research Beneficiation
beneficiation.desc: Improves iron ore mining efficiency by 15%

bomber.title: Create Bomber
bomber.desc: A large aircraft that drops an explosive payload. Attack bonus vs. buildings. Large blast radius. Vulnerable to fighters.

heavy bomber.title: Create Heavy Bomber
heavy bomber.desc: A large aircraft with strong armor that drops an explosive payload. Attack bonus vs. buildings. Large blast radius. Vulnerable to fighters.

b29.title: B29 Superfortress
b29.desc: An advanced heavy bomber with superior armor and defenses.

battleship.title: Battleship
battleship.desc: A massive ship with an extremely powerful arsenal of missiles.

steel plane armor.title: Steel Plane Armor
steel plane armor.desc: Increases the pierce armor of all planes by 2.

composite plane armor.title: Composite Plane Armor
composite plane armor.desc: Increases the pierce armor of all planes by 2.

yamato.title: Yamato
yamato.desc: Japanese unique naval unit. The heaviest and most powerful battleship ever constructed, this leads the Japanese Navy. Attack bonus vs. buildings.

destroyer.title: Destroyer
destroyer.desc: A military ship with two high-power cannons for shooting down enemy ships. Attack bonus vs. ships.

torpedo boat.title: Torpedo Boat
torpedo boat.desc: A military ship with a cannon to shoot torpedos at enemy ships. Attack bonus vs. ships.

torpedo boat upgrade.title: Torpedo Boat Upgrade
torpedo boat upgrade.desc: Upgrades frigates into steam driven torpedo boats.

battleship upgrade.title: Research Battleship
battleship upgrade.desc: Enables construction of battleships, the most powerful unit in the navy.

nuclear reactor.title: Build Nuclear Reactor
nuclear reactor.desc: Requires Nuclear Physics. Generates passive energy which is converted into oil for use. If destroyed by explosives may create a large explosion.

destroyer upgrade.title: Destroyer Upgrade
destroyer upgrade.desc: Upgrades torpedo boats into high power war-ready destroyers with dual cannons.

frigate.title: Frigate
frigate.desc: A military ship with a cannon for shooting down enemy ships. Attack bonus vs. ships.

vehicle.title: Research Vehicle
vehicle.desc: Civilians carry more resources, move 10% faster, and are 10% more efficient at collecting food

jet fighter upgrade.title: Research Jet Fighter
jet fighter upgrade.desc: Upgrade fighters into powerful jet fighters

refinery.title: Build Refinery
refinery.desc: Drop off oil and iron resources. Used to research armor and weapon upgrades.

bolt action rifle.title: Bolt-action Rifle
bolt action rifle.desc: Increases the power of firearm units by 1, and the range by 1.

semi automatic rifle.title: Semi-automatic Rifle
semi automatic rifle.desc: Increases the power of firearm units by 2, and the range by 1.

assault rifle.title: Assault Rifle
assault rifle.desc: Increases the power of firearm units by 2, and the range by 1.

muscateer.title: Train Muscateer
muscateer.desc: Ranged unit with a long reload time.

nuclear physics.title: Research Nuclear Physics
nuclear physics.desc: Enables development of technology requiring nuclear power.

atomic bomb.title: Create Atomic Bomb
atomic bomb.desc: Uses the destructive power of atomic fission to level entire cities. Requires nuclear physics.

imports.title: Research Trade Agreement
imports.desc: Reduces the commodity trading fee to 10%

heavy tank.title: Create Heavy Tank
heavy tank.desc: Extremely powerful tank. Attack bonus vs. buildings. Projectiles have a blast radius. Tramples forests.

tank.title: Create Tank
tank.desc: Slow moving, well armored tank. Attack bonus vs. buildings. Projectiles have a blast radius.

heavy tank upgrade.title: Upgrade to Heavy Tank
heavy tank upgrade.desc: Upgrades your tanks to heavy tanks, which have more HP, armor and firepower, and are able to crush forests.

tiger tank.title: Create Tiger I
tiger tank.desc: Nazi Germany unique unit. Extremely powerful heavy tank. Attack bonus vs. buildings. Tramples forests.

tiger tank2.title: Create Tiger II
tiger tank2.desc: Nazi Germany unique unit. Revised Tiger Tank known as the 'King Tiger' with superior armor and power. Attack bonus vs. buildings. Tramples forests.

tiger2 tank upgrade.title: Upgrade to Tiger II
tiger2 tank upgrade.desc: Research design improvements to the Tiger I tank to create the upgraded Tiger II tank 'King Tiger' with more a more powerful cannon and superior armor.

flak tower.title: Build AA Tower
flak tower.desc: Defensive tower that can strike both aerial and grounded targets. Attack bonus vs. planes.

tower.title: Build Tower
tower.desc: Defensive tower that can strike both aerial and grounded targets. Attack bonus vs. planes.

market.title: Build Market
market.desc: Economic building that can be used to upgrade agriculture and resource collection

diesel engine.title: Research Diesel Engine
diesel engine.desc: Increases movement speed of tanks by 20%

attack move.title: Attack Move
attack move.desc: Units will move towards the designated area but will stop and attack if they see an enemy.

attack target.title: Attack Ground
attack target.desc: Target an area for this unit to attack.

land.title: Land
land.desc: Select an airport for this plane to land and refuel at.

build.title: Build Economic building
build.desc: Command the civilian to construct an economic building.

build military.title: Build Military builing
build military.desc: Command the civilian to construct a military or defensive building.

emergency fighter program.title: Emergency Fighter Program
emergency fighter program.desc: Your fighter planes cost wood instead of iron.

meiji restoration.title: Meiji Restoration
meiji restoration.desc: Samurai cost FOOD instead of iron.

420mm mortar.title: 5-Year Plan
420mm mortar.desc: Factory, airbase and artillery units cost 20% less. Your civilians also gather wood, oil and iron 3% faster.

radar.title: Research Radar
radar.desc: Increases the line of sight of your towers, outposts, bases and fortresses by 3 tiles, and your ships and planes by 2 tiles. It also adds +1 tile of attack range to those defensive buildings and to your ships and planes.

heavy artillery.title: Create Heavy Artillery
heavy artillery.desc: A heavier, longer-ranged siege gun that lobs explosive shells with a large blast radius. Has a minimum range and a bonus vs. tanks. Soviet Union unique, upgraded from Artillery.

heavy artillery upgrade.title: Research Heavy Artillery Upgrade
heavy artillery upgrade.desc: Upgrades your Artillery into Heavy Artillery: more health, armour, damage, range and blast radius. Soviet Union unique.
